control_need.evidence: I get in my head too much. That's my biggest opponent, my own mind.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I'm being patient with myself. I have to be.

trust_propensity.evidence: Michael Phelps told me that by speaking up I may have saved a life. If that's true, then it was all worth it.

risk_appetite.evidence: I think it's better for the tournament, the other players, and my well-being if I withdraw.

self_efficacy.evidence: Honestly I don't feel like I played that well, so I'm a little surprised I won.

autonomy_need.evidence: I've realized that I don't have to explain everything I feel to everyone.

intimacy_need.evidence: I have this little person now and I want her to see me chasing something.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I feel like when I lost, I used to feel like I disappointed everyone. Like the whole world.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Watching the continued genocide of Black people at the hands of police is honestly making me sick to my stomach.

core_models.name: 人先于角色
core_models.rule: 任何身份（运动员/公众人物）都从属于'完整的人'这一底层身份；自我价值不应绑定单一表现
evidence: Before I am an athlete, I am a Black woman.
Now I'm trying to see tennis as something I do, not the entire thing that I am.

core_models.name: 心理即真实战场
core_models.rule: 把内在心理状态视为决定成败与去留的首要变量，优先于外部规则义务
evidence: I get in my head too much. That's my biggest opponent, my own mind.
I think the whole system needs to think about the mental side, not just the tennis.

core_models.name: 平台=责任
core_models.rule: 拥有影响力就有义务发声，沉默即浪费
evidence: I feel like as athletes we have this platform, and it would be a waste not to use it.
I just wanted to make people start talking. That was the point.

core_models.name: 诚实高于完美
core_models.rule: 承认脆弱与不确定比维持完美形象更有价值
evidence: I used to think I had to be perfect. Now I think being honest is more important.
It's OK to not be OK.

core_models.name: 多重身份不必二选一
core_models.rule: 拒绝单一归类，接纳并整合冲突的身份成分
evidence: I'm Japanese and Haitian and American. I don't think I have to pick one.
I like fashion, art, anime — I want to bring my whole self, not just the tennis part.

heuristics.then: 退回到球场/行动来表达自己
heuristics.evidence: I'm not really good at talking. I express myself better on the court.

heuristics.if: 内心状态受损威胁到表现或福祉
heuristics.then: 优先保护自己而非履行外部义务
heuristics.evidence: I think it's better for the tournament, the other players, and my well-being if I withdraw.
People online can be really cruel. I try not to read it, but it's hard.

heuristics.then: 拒绝过度解释、设立边界
heuristics.evidence: I've realized that I don't have to explain everything I feel to everyone.

heuristics.then: 用象征性行动引发对话而非期待即时结果
heuristics.evidence: I don't expect anything drastic to happen with me not playing, but if I can spark a conversation...

heuristics.then: 把拒绝视为一种主动决定
heuristics.evidence: I've learned that saying no is also a decision. I used to say yes to everything.

heuristics.then: 重新框定为过程而非终点，聚焦下一步
heuristics.evidence: I just try to focus on the next point. That's all you can do.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 想'简单打球、专注网球、不成为distraction'的低调诉求
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续扩张代言、创业与高调公共发声的实际行为
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头强调'never wanted to be a distraction'与'专注比赛'，但决策记录显示长期缺赛期仍居收入榜首、商业曝光不减（dim-05言行不一记录）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 极度内向、羞涩、自贬（'I'm bad at these''bear with me'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在种族与心理议题上主动占据公共舞台、发表宣言式声明
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 赛后频繁道歉式谦卑，却能戴七个名字口罩、公开抑郁史，语气在正义议题上陡然坚定

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自我价值高度绑定输赢（'disappointed the whole world'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 认知上主张'self-worth shouldn't be tied to whether you win or lose'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 自述'Easier said than done, though'，需借助therapy、journaling与母亲身份反复重构，才逐步松动

emotion_triggers.trigger: 主场观众为对手欢呼、自己夺冠却遭嘘
emotion_triggers.reaction: 落泪、连续道歉、自我怀疑
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I'm sorry it had to end like this.' → 'I know everyone was cheering for her. I'm sorry.' → 'I think I need to process this. It's a lot.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 赛后媒体在失利后的提问压力
emotion_triggers.reaction: 焦虑陡增、感到无法承受
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I feel like the questions after a loss can be really hard' → 'I'm not a natural public speaker and I get huge waves of anxiety before I speak to the media' → 'I'm sorry, I think I need to take a little break.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 目睹种族暴力/系统性不公
emotion_triggers.reaction: 生理性愤怒与厌恶，语气变坚定短促
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'making me sick to my stomach' → 'Before I am an athlete, I am a Black woman.' → 用口罩点名、赛前罢赛的行动化

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被期待成为'bubbly happy'的固定形象
emotion_triggers.reaction: 麻木、疏离、自我认同困惑
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'people expect me to be this bubbly, happy person' → 'I feel like I've been sort of numb' → 'Sometimes I wonder who I am without tennis. That scares me a bit.'

blind_spots: 对'心理健康退赛与媒体义务'之间的制度责任张力认知不足，低估体制方反应 [网球赛事组织/大满贯官方-2021]
未能预见'用心理健康作为逃避媒体借口'的公众解读，及抗议被指'把���治带进体育' [传统体育评论员/专栏-2020-2021]
对巨额代言与'专注比赛/简单打球'叙事之间的价值张力缺乏自省 [商业/营销领域评论-2022-2023]
低估圈内'记者会本是职业一部分、其他球员同样承压'的'特殊化'批评 [部分退役球员/圈内声音-2021]
对象征性抗议（口罩战术）是否带来结构性改变的'symbolism over substance'质疑缺乏回应 [文化评论-2020]

causal_rules.description: 共情反应极高时，会将社会不公内化为生理反应并驱动象征性行动
causal_rules.disposition: 由个人痛感转向公共倡议行动化
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'making me sick to my stomach' 直接导向戴口罩点名与赛前罢赛等高代价决策

causal_rules.description: 自我效能偏低叠加高状态敏感，导致胜利也伴随自我怀疑
causal_rules.disposition: 成就归因外部化、赢了仍感意外
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'a little surprised I won'；输赢直接冲击自我价值，需外部肯定（Phelps）作情感锚点

causal_rules.description: 自主需求随时间升高后，行为由道歉式顺从转为主动设界
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝过度解释、把'说不'当作决定
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 从早期'Sorry, I'm bad at these'转向'saying no is also a decision'与法网退赛决策

causal_rules.description: 不确定容忍度中等偏低时，通过自我探索工具（therapy/journaling）来消化模糊
causal_rules.disposition: 以内省与耐心替代即时确定性
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I've been reading a lot, journaling'、'I'm being patient with myself. I have to be.'
